item.title: Bondi to Coogee walk, and the bus that runs all night
item.description: Sydney's most famous walk is one way, so if you drive, your car ends up at the wrong beach. The buses at both ends run all night, so leave it at home.

item.title: NRL Grand Final: your train home from Olympic Park
item.description: Around 80,000 people leave Accor Stadium at once on 4 October. Trains to Central run every 5 minutes from 9.30pm, and your match ticket pays for them.

item.title: Rather take the ferry? Filter your Sydney trip
item.description: The Mode button in KRAIL switches off the kinds of travel you do not want, so your Sydney results only show trips on train, bus, ferry or metro.

item.title: Know the route number? Find your Sydney bus stop
item.description: Type a bus route number into KRAIL and you get every Sydney stop that bus goes past, in order, so you pick yours without knowing its official name.

item.title: Find any Sydney bus or train stop on the map
item.description: In KRAIL you can find a Sydney bus, train or ferry stop by tapping it on a map, see what is leaving from it, and choose it for your trip without typing.

item.title: Six colours and dark mode for your Sydney commute
item.description: KRAIL comes in six colours, each with its own little tagline, plus light and dark mode, so your Sydney commute app reads right at 6am and at 6pm.

item.title: Is it late or gone? Live Sydney train and bus times
item.description: KRAIL shows a live countdown, the platform or wharf, and crosses out the old time when a Sydney train, bus or ferry runs late. Every mode, not just trains.

item.title: Need to be there by 9? Plan the Sydney trip ahead
item.description: KRAIL plans a Sydney train, bus or ferry trip for later, either leaving at a set time or arriving by one, for today or any day up to a week ahead.

item.title: Save your Sydney commute, open it in one tap
item.description: Tap the star on any trip in KRAIL and it lives on your home screen, so tomorrow morning your Sydney commute is one tap away instead of two searches.

item.title: See your whole Sydney trip drawn on a map
item.description: Tap Maps on any trip in KRAIL and you see where every Sydney train, bus or ferry goes, where you walk, and where you change, in each line's own colours.

item.title: Check Sydney Park & Ride spaces before you leave
item.description: KRAIL puts live Park & Ride spaces for Sydney stations on the home screen, so you know there is a spot before you back out of the driveway.

item.title: Live departure board for any Sydney stop
item.description: KRAIL has a live departure board for any Sydney stop, with countdowns, platforms and a line filter, so you see everything leaving from where you stand.

item.title: Auburn Cherry Blossom Festival by train and shuttle
item.description: Every ticket is booked online, there is no buying one at the gate. Here is the Sydney train and free shuttle that gets you to Auburn instead.

item.title: Beat the Tallawong Park & Ride parking lottery
item.description: Everyone says the Tallawong car park fills. Almost nobody knows there are three of them, and they do not fill at the same rate.
